description: Core infrastructure: ToastService, ToastComponent, ConfirmDialogComponent, SkeletonLoaderComponent, scroll restoration, production URL fix, prefers-reduced-motion, skip-to-content, aria-live cart badge. These are foundational pieces other features depend on.
steps: 2. Create src/app/core/services/toast.service.ts: Injectable providedIn root service with signals. Must have methods: success(message, duration?), error(message, duration?), info(message, duration?), warning(message, duration?). Store toast items as signal<{id, type, message, duration}[]>. Auto-remove after duration (default 4000ms). Expose a readonly toasts signal.

3. Create src/app/shared/components/toast/ directory with toast.component.ts, toast.component.html, toast.component.scss. Standalone component using ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush. Import ToastService via inject(). Display toasts from service with proper animations, dismiss button. Position fixed bottom-right. Use BEM naming. Use design tokens. Add aria-live='polite' and role='status'.

4. Create src/app/shared/components/confirm-dialog/ directory with confirm-dialog.component.ts, confirm-dialog.component.html, confirm-dialog.component.scss. Standalone component with ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush. Create a ConfirmDialogService at src/app/core/services/confirm-dialog.service.ts that exposes an open(config: {title, message, confirmLabel?, cancelLabel?}) method returning Observable<boolean>. The component must have focus trap (trap Tab/Shift+Tab within dialog), aria-modal='true', role='dialog', aria-labelledby, keyboard support (Escape to cancel). Use existing design tokens and BEM.

5. Create src/app/shared/components/skeleton-loader/ directory with skeleton-loader.component.ts, skeleton-loader.component.html, skeleton-loader.component.scss. Standalone component with ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush. Inputs: type ('card'|'text'|'image'), count (number, default 1). Use the existing %skeleton-shimmer placeholder from _design-tokens.scss via @extend or recreate the same gradient animation. BEM naming.

6. Update src/app/app.config.ts: import withInAppNavigation from @angular/router and add withInAppNavigation({scrollPositionRestoration: 'enabled'}) to provideRouter. The signature becomes provideRouter(routes, withInAppNavigation({scrollPositionRestoration: 'enabled'})).

7. Update src/styles.scss: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block at the end that sets * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }.

8. Update src/app/layout/public-layout/public-layout.component.html: Add a skip-to-content link before : Skip to content. Change
to
. Add ToastComponent after the footer.
9. Update src/app/layout/public-layout/public-layout.component.ts: Import ToastComponent and add to imports array.
10. Update src/app/layout/public-layout/public-layout.component.scss: Add .skip-to-content styles (visually hidden by default, visible on focus with position absolute, z-index above everything).
11. Update src/app/layout/header/header.component.html: Add aria-live='polite' to the cart badge span element (the one with class header__cart-badge).
12. Add ConfirmDialogComponent to the public layout (import it in public-layout.component.ts, add <app-confirm-dialog /> after the toast).
acceptance_criteria: ToastService exists with success/error/info/warning methods using signals
ToastComponent is a standalone component with OnPush, displays toasts, has dismiss, aria-live
ConfirmDialogService exists with open() method returning Observable<boolean>
ConfirmDialogComponent has focus trap, aria-modal, role=dialog, keyboard support
SkeletonLoaderComponent exists with type and count inputs, uses shimmer animation
styles.scss has prefers-reduced-motion media query reducing all animations
PublicLayoutComponent has skip-to-content link (visually hidden, visible on focus)
ToastComponent and ConfirmDialogComponent are rendered in public layout
verification: Run 'npx ng build 2>&1 | head -50' to check for TypeScript compilation errors (may fail due to missing deps but should show TS errors if any)
Verify all new files exist with correct structure using ls and reading key files
Verify imports are correct by reading the modified files
